summary.he: שירות הזהות והכניסה כיום — בינארי Go יחיד שמחליף את authentik (core-006)
summary.en: The identity and forward-auth service — one Go binary, replacing authentik (core-006)

data.note: Its one fact — who may sign in — is the users file in data/forward-auth/state (the forward_auth_data volume until DGO-2019 moved it), written once at first-run setup (DGO-1090); during a migration it also reads authentik's own database, never writing it. lan-console's sign-in reads the same folder, read-only.
